title: L-Lysine for Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: L-Lysine for Hair Loss & Shedding: Research, Iron & Safety | FullyVital
seo_description: What reviews report about L-lysine and iron in women with hair shedding, why lysine alone isn't proven, and what a safety review found.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.

Old post (0 study links) made unsourced claims. Rewritten around two reviews from one research group and a safety review; the article notes both hair reviews come from the same group and tested lysine with iron.
flags: Discusses chronic telogen effluvium (a hair-loss diagnosis) as the studied population; informational. The authors' wording ('stops the excessive hair loss') was left out because the abstract is cut off.
Evidence is from a single research group and combines lysine with iron; the article says so.
'Ask your doctor to check your iron (ferritin)' is general advice; Rushton mentions ferritin as a measure of iron status.
